caption: what just happened in the sky this month. tomorrow venus enters aquarius; mercury turns direct mar 3.

slides.headline: what just happened in the *sky* this february?
a ring of fire *eclipse* reset aquarius
slides.body: the annular solar eclipse at 17.6° aquarius. if you started something then, it's three weeks old now.

slides.headline: *mercury* turned around in pisces
slides.body: it's still retrograde, now back in aquarius, until mar 3.

slides.headline: the quietest *eclipse* of the year so far
slides.body: a penumbral lunar eclipse in virgo. barely visible. still, a good night to put one fix down.

slides.headline: *mars* backed into leo, still retrograde
slides.body: old pride came back for review. you don't have to reopen the case.

slides.headline: tomorrow *venus* moves into aquarius
slides.body: and mercury turns direct mar 3. today's last quarter moon in sagittarius says: tidy up first.

slides.headline: new month, new deck. there's always an *11:11*.
